beats.headline: Nice shoes
beats.text: The fairy crawler goes into a tree, and I take the Gate of the Feral Gods from her. Carl comes into the clearing. My colonel's mark fades, and our dots turn to a colour no army on this floor has used. Three of mine see to Stalwart. Then I look at Carl, and at his bare feet. Nice shoes, I tell him, and we teleport away.

beats.headline: Sharing a command he did not ask for
beats.text: We hold the castle at Larracos. Six hours more and the floor is ours. That should be the whole of the announcement. Instead the system lists two warlords of the War Mage Rebellion, and only one of them is mine. Agatha. Co-warlord. I did not bring this rebellion this far to share its title, least of all with her, and I have not hidden what I think of that. I will hold the castle. I will not pretend to be pleased.

beats.headline: He leaves, and warns them on the way
beats.text: To the Warlord Chat, for the record. The War Mage Rebellion is leaving this floor. We came here for the Scavenger's Daughter. We have found the Scavenger's Daughter, and we leave with what we came for; the castle and the war are yours to finish. One thing more, and I address it to Carl and to Donut, since they are the ones who might still act on it. Agatha is an enemy to all of you. I do not explain. I am already gone.

beats.headline: A note in a gremlin's hand
beats.text: For Carl alone. I send it by a gremlin, who puts it into his costumed hand: a blank invoice from the C&W&U, with a crude drawing on it for anybody watching, and under it words that surface only for his Escape Plan skill. Tell no one. Kill two teams in the next heat. Come when the shop opens after that race, ask for the top-shelf upgrades, and I will explain why. We do not have to be enemies. We want the same thing. I can smuggle friends to the Pineapple Cabaret. Come alone.

beats.headline: He said to come alone
beats.text: The upgrade imp is dead on the counter and my note is in his overalls, in crayon, on a kiddie menu. Carl, you were supposed to come alone. He does not come alone. He brings the cat, the goat, three frightened mercenaries and all the rest, disarms my trap, opens my door and tells me anything I say to him I say to everyone. I have my milkshake. I begin to explain how badly he needs me. I do not get to the second sentence.

beats.headline: Why nothing in the dungeon survives
beats.text: For the record, under an anti-magic shield. The dungeon is out of spare mobs, the NPCs know what they are, and everything inside will be destroyed when the season closes, NPC and indentured crawler alike. The framework is reused; its contents are binned. Our exit is the Pineapple Cabaret, a pocket dimension behind the seventeenth floor, infested since we left it. The Rebellion needs a fighting force. No one who worships a god may enter. I had Carl kill two teams so that the system would set him against his friends. He breaks my nose.
